definitions.explanation: Something or someone that provides support, whether physical (holding something up) or emotional/figurative (being a source of strength or encouragement). Often used for people who serve as a source of emotional strength.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}の{支|ささ}えがあった。
examples.english: I had the support of my family.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{私|わたし}の{心|こころ}の{支|ささ}えだ。
{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}の{支|ささ}えのおかげで、{困難|こんなん}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}えることができた。
examples.english: Thanks to the support of many people, I was able to overcome the difficulties.

notes:
USAGE:
The noun form of the verb {支|ささ}える (to support). Frequently used in the pattern ～の{支|ささ}え (the support of ~) to express gratitude for emotional or practical help from others. Very common in speeches and thank-you messages.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心|こころ}の{支|ささ}え: emotional support
- {精神的|せいしんてき}な{支|ささ}え: psychological support
- {大|おお}きな{支|ささ}え: great support
- ～の{支|ささ}えなしには: without the support of ~
